mechanism: Modafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce darunavir plasma concentrations, potentially compromising antiretroviral efficacy; darunavir is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase modafinil levels.
action: Monitor antiretroviral effectiveness and modafinil levels; consider alternative wakefulness promoter or adjust darunavir dosing if needed; ensure adequate viral load suppression.
